tagline: A calm, tree-lined Asian side neighbourhood — good local cafés, a beloved city park, and a residential character that attracts families and long-term residents.

items.name: Göztepe Parkı Çay Bahçesi
items.description: A beautiful tea garden inside Göztepe Park with a pond, trees, and a peaceful atmosphere. One of the Asian side's most pleasant park cafés.

items.name: Göztepe Lokantalari
items.description: A cluster of good lokanta restaurants in the Göztepe neighbourhood. Traditional Turkish home cooking at local prices.

items.name: Göztepe Parkı
items.description: A well-maintained neighbourhood park with walking paths, a pond, rose gardens, and a tea garden. Popular with families and joggers.

tips: Göztepe is on the M4 metro line — direct to Kadıköy and the airport.
A genuinely residential neighbourhood. Come for the park and local feel, not nightlife.
Erenköy (south) and Kozyatağı (east) have similar characters.
Property prices are lower than Moda or Kadıköy — popular with expat families for the longer term.
